text: ZDHC (Zero Discharge of Hazardous Chemicals) 21 leading brands committed to advance towards zero discharge of hazardous chemicals in the textile and footwear supply chain and act to improve their environmental performance.
text_raw:
ZDHC (Zero Discharge 
of Hazardous 
Chemicals)
21 leading brands committed to advance 
towards zero discharge of hazardous 
chemicals in the textile and footwear 
supply chain and act to improve their 
environmental performance.

text: ZDHC Joint Roadmap Demonstrates the ZDHC group’s collaborative goals in leading the apparel and footwear industry towards zero discharge of hazardous chemicals for all products across all pathways by 2020.

text: Zero Waste The design and management of products and processes to systematically avoid and eliminate the volume and toxicity of waste and materials, conserve and recover all resources, and not burn or bury them.
text_raw:
Zero Waste
The design and management of products

and eliminate the volume and toxicity

recover all resources, and not burn or 
bury them.

text: Zibeline Zibeline is a thick, soft fabric with a long nap.
text_raw:
Zibeline
Zibeline is a thick, soft fabric with a 
long nap.

text: It is usually made of wool, such as mohair or alpaca, but can also be made from the hair of other animals, such as camels.
text_raw:
It is usually made of wool, 
such as mohair or alpaca, but can also 
be made from the hair of other animals, 
such as camels.

text: Zibeline can also refer to either the sable (Martes zibellina) or its pelt, which zibeline was originally made from.
text_raw:
Zibeline can also refer 
to either the sable (Martes zibellina) or 
its pelt, which zibeline was originally 
made from.

text: Zibeline can also refer to a heavy silk fabric with a twill weave, very similar to Mikado.
text_raw:
Zibeline can also refer to 
a heavy silk fabric with a twill weave, 
very similar to Mikado.

text: Zippers Zippers are hookless fasteners.
text_raw:
Zippers
Zippers are hookless fasteners.

text: They have two rows of ‘teeth’ that slide together to bind and fasten openings on bags, skirts or trousers.
text_raw:

text: Zips can be inserted into a slash or seam with a closed end.
